title: [server] Migrate the REMAINING worker-dispatcher Agent.role consumers (DISCOVERED)

D2_mechanism.why: Returns the role KEY when agentKey names a built-in vteam agent (template rows have agentKey === role -> byte-identical to the old Agent.role value), and EMPTY STRING for custom/clone rows (old Agent.role was null -> `?? ''`). Reuses the existing isVteamAgentName/VTEAM_AGENT_NAMES namespace used by roleToAgentName; no new constant.
rejectedAlternatives: tool-derived rule: no tool predicate separates {product,tester,developer} from project_manager (identical ROLE_BOUNDARIES sets) -> would flip project_manager to the full issue instruction (forbidden).
AgentRole.name: would inject the Chinese label where the prompt today injects the key.
D2_mechanism.fieldDisposition: Fields `role` KEPT on AgentIdentityInfo/TeamMemberInfo (set in ~15 spec fixture literals; removing = TS excess-property churn). Doc comment added: value is now key-derived; rename/delete belongs to todo 8. Recorded per D2.

D3_narrowing.claim: Every template row has agent_key === role; every custom row has agent_key and role IS NULL; no live row has NULL agent_key with a usable role.
D3_narrowing.liveDBQuery: SELECT id, name, role, agent_key, type FROM aiagents.agents ORDER BY type, id; (via docker exec aiagents-compose-db mysql)
D3_narrowing.liveDBRows: 7 templates: a_architect|architect|architect, a_developer|developer|developer, a_librarian|librarian|librarian, a_plan|plan|plan, a_product|product|product, a_project_manager|project_manager|project_manager, a_tester|tester|tester; 3 customs: a_0000000001 (role NULL, key myagent), a_0000000002 (role NULL, key t4-dev-t4-mu8fnf18), a_0000000004 (role NULL, key t4-dev-t4-mu8fnzad)
D3_narrowing.liveDBCounts: null_agentKey=0; template_with(agent_key<>role)=0; custom_with_role_not_null=0; null_key_with_usable_role=0; null_role=3; total=10
D3_narrowing.conclusion: The narrowing is behaviour-preserving for every live row: templates keep the same vteam-<key> candidate (agentKey === role); customs keep theirs via agentKey; no row loses a candidate.
